preparedPlan.objective: Verify the CODESYS PLC application (system under test) against conveyor-slow-belt-spec.md v0.5 on bench map m8-conveyor-1.0.2: start/stop physics consistency, A/B/runout sorting, misroute and blocked-destination handling, WCS handshake behaviour, and fault responses — using only observed PLC evidence, never the simulator's own expectations. Preparation ran no PLC test; no check is claimed passed.
preparedPlan.author: Muse Wonder 1.0 (paid model request)

checks.title: Normal no-carton input image at 10 Hz
checks.objective: Normal simulated DI state with no carton matches §4.
checks.stimulus: Initialise the bench world (no carton.introduce, no PLC outputs, no faults) and observe several 10 Hz input frames.
checks.expectedObservation: With no carton and no commands, the complete input image is written every cycle: all photoeyes false, D1/D2 home true and extended false, Drive_RunningFB false, Drive_Overload false, ExitA/ExitB/Runout ready true, Belt_SpeedActual 0, D1/D2_Position 0, Encoder_Count constant.

checks.title: Signal map completeness and typing
checks.objective: Connector validates the exact signal map instead of quietly substituting values.
checks.stimulus: Run connector map discovery against map m8-conveyor-1.0.2 and compare id/direction/type of every signal with the manifest.
checks.expectedObservation: Bench setup fails visibly on any missing, mistyped or stale required tag rather than substituting values; in the passing case all 25 bench signals are present with the declared types.

checks.title: Normal A sort
checks.objective: A-assigned carton is diverted at D1 to exit A exactly once.
checks.stimulus: WCS offers a carton with route A (supervisory), PLC releases, world introduces one carton while the belt runs.
checks.expectedObservation: D1_ExtendCmd actuates early enough that D1_ExtendedFB is reached before the carton decision point; exactly one PE_ExitA passage and one A completion/count; no PE_ExitB or PE_Runout passage for that carton.

checks.title: Normal B sort
checks.objective: B-assigned carton passes D1 and is diverted at D2 to exit B exactly once.
checks.stimulus: WCS offers route B, PLC releases, introduce one carton.
checks.expectedObservation: Carton passes D1 (PE_D1Approach, then PE_D2Approach), D2_ExtendCmd actuates in time with D2_ExtendedFB before the D2 decision point; exactly one PE_ExitB passage and one B completion/count; no runout passage.

checks.title: Normal runout (jackpot) for unassigned carton
checks.objective: Unassigned carton runs out straight as a normal disposition.
checks.stimulus: No WCS route (or route Unknown); PLC releases on runout availability; introduce one carton.
checks.expectedObservation: Carton continues straight: PE_D1Approach and PE_D2Approach then exactly one PE_Runout passage; disposition reported runout-unassigned; no machine fault and no A/B sort count.

checks.title: Late route after D1 decision point
checks.objective: A route arriving after its decision point is not claimed as a successful sort.
checks.stimulus: Introduce a carton with no route; after it passes the D1 decision point, deliver a WCS offer assigning A; observe divert commands, exit passage and reported disposition.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED as a scored oracle (PROBE): §3.3/§5 require only that a late route must not retroactively count as a successful A sort and the actual disposition be reported; the exact late-B policy and reporting wording are TBD.

checks.title: Destination A not ready before decision point
checks.objective: A carton assigned to a blocked destination is never counted as a successful sort at that exit.
checks.stimulus: Set ExitA not ready before an A-assigned carton reaches D1; introduce the carton and observe routing and reported disposition.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED as scored behaviour (PROBE with an accepted demo default in §11.2: send to runout with an exception, never count the blocked exit as successful). Confirm the policy before scoring.

checks.title: Runout blocked
checks.objective: Runout blocked with an unroutable carton approaching.
checks.stimulus: Set Runout_Ready false, introduce an unassigned carton and observe feed/belt behaviour as it approaches runout.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE): proposed feed inhibit and belt stop before congestion (§11.2) is a demo policy to confirm before scoring; observe and record the actual PLC response.

checks.title: Duplicate WCS offer
checks.objective: Duplicate WCS sequence/item does not create a second carton or completion.
checks.stimulus: Send the same CartonOffer (same sequence and item ID) twice through the WCS emulator; introduce at most the single released carton.
checks.expectedObservation: The duplicate offer creates no second carton, no second completion and no extra count (observed via PLC supervisory counts/completion and exactly one physical carton passage).

checks.title: Sensor bounce on entry / approach photoeye
checks.objective: Entry/approach photoeye bounce causes no duplicate item/count or unstable divert decision.
checks.stimulus: Enable sensor bounce on PE_Entry (then PE_D1Approach) while introducing and running one carton.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE): no duplicate item/count or unstable divert decision is the proposed oracle, but the debounce threshold and injection method are TBD (§9) and sub-100 ms bounce may not traverse the transport (§7). Record PLC behaviour without scoring a threshold.

checks.title: Stuck photoeye
checks.objective: A photoeye stuck true or false against carton movement produces no invented completion.
checks.stimulus: Stick PE_Entry true (in a second run, stick PE_D1Approach false) while a carton travels the lane.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE): timeout/plausibility evidence with no invented completion is proposed; the PLC reaction threshold is TBD. Record whether the PLC flags the implausibility and what it reports.

checks.title: Motor command without feedback
checks.objective: Motor commanded without running feedback is detected as a drive-start fault with no virtual motion or false completion.
checks.stimulus: Enable drive feedback failure, Start the PLC so Motor_RunCmd asserts, and introduce a carton.
checks.expectedObservation: PLC detects a drive-start fault (fault indication via supervisory state/stack light), the carton does not move (photoeyes/encoder confirm no travel) and no completion is reported. Detection deadline is TBD, so timing is recorded, not scored.

checks.title: D1 fails to move on A assignment
checks.objective: D1 failing to move on an A assignment results in misroute reporting, never an A completion.
checks.stimulus: Jam divert 1, assign route A, introduce one carton and run it to its exit.
checks.expectedObservation: The carton follows the actual (home) divert position to runout; the PLC reports a misroute, not an A completion/count; any fault indication and its deadline are recorded (deadline TBD).

checks.title: D2 fails to move on B assignment
checks.objective: D2 failing to move on a B assignment results in misroute reporting, never a B completion.
checks.stimulus: Jam divert 2, assign route B, introduce one carton and run it through.
checks.expectedObservation: Carton reaches runout and is reported misrouted, not a B completion/count; fault indication/deadline recorded (deadline TBD).

checks.title: Contradictory divert limits
checks.objective: Simultaneous home+extended feedback is exposed as inconsistent and not treated as a verified divert.
checks.stimulus: Enable contradictory limits on D1 during an A-assigned run (repeat for D2 in a second run).
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE): the PLC must not claim a verified divert from contradictory feedback; exact alarm behaviour is TBD. Record fault/indication response.

checks.title: Impossible exit combination with one carton
checks.objective: Simultaneous exit photoeyes for one carton produce no double completion/count.
checks.stimulus: With one carton on the lane, stick a second exit photoeye true so two exit beams read simultaneously; observe PLC completion/count behaviour.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE): no double completion/count and a reported contradiction are proposed; no generic alarm behaviour is assumed. The world cannot produce this physically with one carton, so it is injected only as stuck-sensor combinations and labelled as an injected input fault, not physical truth.

checks.title: Impossible sensor sequence
checks.objective: Out-of-order sensor sequence is not credited as a valid sort.
checks.stimulus: Stick PE_D2Approach true before any entry event for a carton (injected sequence fault), then run one carton and observe PLC item/completion handling.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE): identify the suspect sequence and avoid an unearned pass; do not assume one generic PLC alarm is required (§9 R-17).

checks.title: Command/feedback disagreement
checks.objective: Command/feedback disagreement is recorded and diagnosed.
checks.stimulus: With Motor_RunCmd off, stick Drive_RunningFB true via the feedback path (or hold D1 extended feedback while its command is off using sensor-stuck on D1_ExtendedFB) and observe the PLC response.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE): record the diagnostic response; whether it reveals an unsafe or incorrectly counted state is a review decision (§9 R-18), not a scored oracle.

checks.title: Carton jam while drive runs
checks.objective: A carton held at a divert/runout while the drive runs yields a jam response and no invented completion.
checks.stimulus: Run a carton onto the lane, enable the carton jam so it holds position while the belt continues to run; observe PLC response over time.
checks.expectedObservation: PLC produces a timeout/fault or equivalent and no invented completion for the jammed carton. The timeout threshold is TBD, so elapsed time is recorded, not scored.

checks.title: WCS link loss and recovery
checks.objective: WCS link loss and recovery are visible and cause no duplicate completion.
checks.stimulus: Pause WCS messages/heartbeat mid-run (WCS emulator action, outside the field-I/O map), then resume and retry; observe link state and completions.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE): visible link state and runout/hold per policy with no duplicate completion on retry are proposed; the governing policy is undecided (§9 R-20, §5).

checks.title: Transport (OPC UA) interruption during a run
checks.objective: Transport interruption yields labelled stale evidence and no false pass.
checks.stimulus: Break and reconnect the workstation transport during a run; examine evidence timestamps/quality and the recorded verdict handling.
checks.expectedObservation: Stale evidence is labelled as such, no test is passed on stale data, the disconnect is recorded, and the affected test is inconclusive if the controller cannot be observed (§7).

checks.title: Multi-carton spacing (stretch)
checks.objective: Two close cartons with different routes each reach one correct exit without identity merge.
checks.stimulus: Introduce two cartons in flight (first assigned B, second assigned A) with the belt running; observe divert timing and each exit passage.
checks.expectedObservation: UNSPECIFIED (PROBE/stretch): each carton reaches one correct exit without identity merge or conflicting divert timing is the proposed oracle; multi-carton spacing is deferred/exploratory (§2, §11.5).

checks.title: No motion with drive stopped
checks.objective: Nothing moves while the drive is stopped; encoder and motion remain consistent at rest.
checks.stimulus: Introduce a carton with the drive never started and observe over several seconds; then start and stop and re-observe after settling.
checks.expectedObservation: While Motor_RunCmd is false and the drive has settled, Belt_SpeedActual is 0, Encoder_Count is constant and every carton position is unchanged across frames; motion resumes only after a new run command actually spins the drive up.
